KNAVERY.Name: Name
KNAVERY.BiographyPlaceholder: Click to write who this knave is.
KNAVERY.AbilityTip: Roll a {name} check: d20 + bonus. Its defense (what others must beat) is {defense}.
KNAVERY.DefenseTip: Defense: 11 + the bonus. An opposed check must reach this.
KNAVERY.SavesTip: Saving throws from other games, rolled as the matching ability check.
KNAVERY.HPTip: Hit points. Damage comes off HP first; at 0 HP each further point is a wound.
KNAVERY.ACTip: Armor class: 11 + armor points ({ap}). Type a value to override it.
KNAVERY.ACAuto: Worked out from the armor you wear.
KNAVERY.ACOverrideActive: Overridden by hand. Use the arrow to go back to the worn armor.
KNAVERY.ACReset: Go back to the armor you wear
KNAVERY.WoundsTip: Wounds fill item slots from the top down. Every slot wounded means death.
KNAVERY.CoinsTip: Coins. Every 500 fill an item slot.
KNAVERY.NextLevelTip: XP needed for the next level.
KNAVERY.RestTip: A night's sleep after a meal: HP back to full, spellbooks ready again.
KNAVERY.HealWoundTip: Rest in a safe haven to heal one wound.
KNAVERY.DieOfFateTip: Roll a d6 when fate, not skill, should decide.
KNAVERY.LevelUpBody: Reaching level {level}. Choose {n} different abilities to raise by one, or let the dice choose.
KNAVERY.LevelUpHpHint: Max HP is rerolled with {level}d6. If the roll is not above {max}, max HP becomes {max} + 1.
KNAVERY.LevelUpHpKept: Rolled {rolled}, not above the old maximum: max HP is now {max}.
KNAVERY.NoCareersHint: No careers. In Character Creation Mode, roll or pick them here, or drop a career item on the sheet.
KNAVERY.RemoveCareerConfirm: Remove the career {name}? Items it granted stay.
KNAVERY.FeaturesHint: Fields this career adds to the character sheet. The key names where the value is stored.
KNAVERY.CareerKeyTip: A short id for storing this career's feature values. Leave blank to use the name.
KNAVERY.StartingItemsHint: Type an item name and press Enter, or drop an item here.
KNAVERY.EffectsHint: Active Effects on a career apply to whoever holds it, e.g. +1 to max HP.
KNAVERY.CreationModeHintOn: Character Creation Mode is on: dice and pick-lists appear, the marketplace lets you take gear, and Level Up shows when you have the XP.
KNAVERY.CreationModeHintOff: Turn on Character Creation Mode to reroll parts of the sheet and level up.
KNAVERY.AttackTip: Attack: d20 + STR (melee) or WIS (ranged) against the target's AC.
KNAVERY.SpellsLeftTip: You may use as many spellbooks per day as your INT.
KNAVERY.SlotIndexTip: The slot or slots this item sits in. Wounds fill slots from the top.
KNAVERY.ReorderHint: Drag rows to reorder. The bottom rows are wounded first.
KNAVERY.BundleTip: How many of these share one slot (e.g. 20 arrows).

Status.NoHpText: Further damage fills slots with wounds.
Status.WoundedText: Items in wounded slots must be dropped.

KNAVERY.MoraleTip: Morale: roll 2d6; at or under MRL they stand firm.
KNAVERY.NpcACTip: Armor class. Worn armor adds to it.
KNAVERY.NpcLevelTip: Level: the bonus this creature adds to every check and attack.
KNAVERY.NpcCheckTip: A check with the creature's level as its bonus.
KNAVERY.NpcUsesLevel: Adds its level (+{n}) to every check.

Roll.Mode2d20Hint: Advantage rolls two d20s and keeps the higher; disadvantage keeps the lower.
Roll.RollDamageToo: Roll damage at the same time
Roll.PowerAttackHint: Double the damage dice. The weapon breaks.
Roll.PowerAttackUsed: Power attack: double damage dice, and the weapon breaks.
Roll.FreeManeuver: 21 or more: a free maneuver as well.
Roll.ApplyHint: Apply to the hit targets, or to your targeted or selected tokens.
Roll.ApplyDirectHint: Direct damage skips HP and wounds a character at once; a creature takes it tripled.

Damage.Title: {name} takes {n} damage
Damage.DropWounded: Drop whatever sits in the wounded slots.

Spell.ChaosNote: A chaos spellbook: it becomes a different spell at the next dawn.
Spell.DailyLimit: You can only use {n} spellbooks per day.

Glog.AlreadyHasOne: This character already has a grimoire.
Glog.NoGrimoire: No grimoire to bind it into.
Glog.NoScrolls: Scrolls cannot be bound into a grimoire.
Glog.MdTip: Magic Dice left today. Dice showing 1–3 come back; a rest refills them all.
Glog.Mishap: Doubles: a mishap! (The GLOG Mishaps table is empty.)

Offer.NoTargets: There is nobody to give it to.
Offer.OverburdenBody: {target} has no free slot for {item}. Take it anyway?
Offer.GiverOffline: {giver}'s player is offline; the offer waits for them.
Offer.Failed: The hand-over failed; the offer is open again.

Refused.Answered: That offer has already been answered.
Refused.Busy: That offer is being handed over right now.

Market.Title: Marketplace: {name}
Market.TakeHint: Take it without paying (the Game Master, or Character Creation Mode).
Market.ManagerHint: Aisles are roll tables named "Market: …". Shipped aisles are read-only: Customize makes a world copy that replaces them.
Market.DeleteAisleConfirm: Delete the aisle {name}? A shipped aisle of the same name comes back.
Market.ShippedHint: Ships with the system. Customize it to change prices or stock.
Market.Customized: {name} is now a world aisle you can edit.
Market.CustomizeFirst: Customize this aisle first; shipped aisles are read-only.
Market.DropHint: Drop items here to stock them.

Dashboard.Title: Game Master's Dashboard
Dashboard.ReasonHint: What the players see, e.g. "The floor gives way!"
Dashboard.DamageHint: Roll damage and apply it, the Knave way: HP first, then wounds.
Dashboard.SelectNpcs: Select the NPC tokens that test morale.
Dashboard.DiceHint: These rolls are whispered to you.
Dashboard.TablesHint: Shipped tables are empty shells. Import your own rows; the world copy is used from then on.

Import.Title: Import a table
Import.Intro: Paste rows to create or replace a world table. A world table overrides the shipped shell of the same name.
Import.Formats: One row per line. Ranges like "01-05" or "7." are kept; plain lines are numbered in order. Careers: "Name: item, item, item" gives starting items. Link a document with @UUID[…]{Name}.

Gen.Intro: Roll a knave at random, or start from a blank sheet and build one by hand.
Gen.LevelHint: The Game Master sets which levels you may start at.
Gen.RandomHint: abilities, HP, careers, coins, spellbooks and portrait, rolled for the chosen level.
Gen.BlankHint: an empty sheet in Character Creation Mode, for building by hand.
Gen.RerollConfirm: Reroll {name} from scratch? Items and careers are replaced.
Gen.NoCareerTable: The Careers table is empty; pick careers by hand.
Gen.NoSpellTable: The Spells table is empty; no spellbooks rolled.
Gen.NoNameTable: The Names table is empty; the knave is nameless for now.

Art.UrlPlaceholder: …or paste an image path or URL
Art.CustomEmpty: Put images in the "{folder}" folder of your user data, then rescan.
Art.CreditAspeheim: Portraits by Jon Aspeheim, CC BY 4.0.
Art.CreditLydia: Art by Lydia Comer, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

Notify.RandomizationDisabled: The Game Master has turned off the creation tools.
Notify.CreationClosed: The Game Master has turned off character creation.
Notify.CreationRequested: Asked the Game Master to create your character.
Notify.NoGmForCreation: A Game Master must be online to create your character.
Notify.NoGmForDamage: A Game Master must be online to damage tokens you don't own.
Notify.TableEmpty: The "{name}" table is still empty. The Game Master can import rows from the dashboard.
Notify.MarketplaceEmpty: The marketplace has nothing for sale.
Notify.Overburdened: {name} is carrying more than they have slots for.
Notify.NoCareers: No careers found. Import the Careers table or create career items.
Notify.NotEnoughXp: Not enough XP for the next level yet.
Notify.PickThree: Choose {n} different abilities, or press Random.
Notify.PrintBlocked: The browser blocked the print window. Allow pop-ups for this site.
Notify.NpcRollManual: NPCs aren't rolled; drop stats in from the bestiary.
Notify.GmOnly: Only the Game Master can do that.

Settings.GroupGeneralHint: Advantage, rolls, traits and the change log.
Settings.GroupGenerationHint: Who may create characters, and at what levels.
Settings.GroupHacksHint: Optional rules: the GLOG grimoire, hard-mode wounds and hazard dice.
Settings.AdvantageModeHint: Knave 2e as written adds or subtracts 5. The 2d20 style rolls two d20s and keeps the higher or lower.
Settings.RollDamageDefault: Roll damage with attacks by default
Settings.RollDamageDefaultHint: Ticks "Roll damage at the same time" on every attack prompt.
Settings.WeaponBreaksHint: Marks the weapon broken when an attack rolls a natural 1.
Settings.ShowTraitsHint: The trait list on the Description tab.
Settings.ChangeLogHint: Whisper a card listing what anyone changed by hand on a sheet.
Settings.AllowPlayerRandomization: Players may use the creation tools
Settings.AllowPlayerRandomizationHint: Character Creation Mode, its dice and pick-lists, Roll Character and Level Up.
Settings.MinCreationLevelHint: The lowest level a new character may start at.
Settings.MaxCreationLevelHint: The highest level a new character may start at.
Settings.CustomPortraitFolderHint: A folder in your user data. Its images appear first in the portrait picker and are used for random portraits.
Settings.AllowPlayerMarketplaceHint: Shows the Marketplace button on character sheets.
Settings.CoinsTakeSlotsHint: Every 500 coins fill an item slot.
Settings.EnableGlogGrimoireHint: Characters may keep a grimoire and cast bound spells with Magic Dice.
Settings.HardModeWoundsHint: An item in a wounded slot breaks.
Settings.ShowHazardDiceHint: Dungeon and travel hazard dice buttons.
